The future of healthcare is being built right now. Come deliver this transformation.




ABOUT THE ROLE

Running a healthcare practice is hard. It's a highly regulated, low-margin business. Practices deliver care upfront, then have to navigate a complex insurance system to get paid. Much of that work is manual, and it isn't always clear which claims or tasks are worth tackling first. When a practice can't operate efficiently, patients are impacted through reduced access to care or unexpected out-of-pocket costs.

Our Claims team builds software that helps clinics and hospitals get paid for the care they deliver. We build automations that can be configured to fit each practice's needs, ensuring their entire business pipeline functions smoothly.

We also build tools that help billers and administrators figure out where their time will have the biggest impact. We help them go after the highest ROI work first, work claims in bulk, and spot trends early that need their attention. We're also building AI agents as coworkers that can take on work between fixed automations and fully manual workflows and make customer onboarding and billing setup more accurate and automated. The end goal is to help clinics and hospitals work more efficiently and collect more of the revenue they've earned.

As a Software Engineer II, you'll work across the stack, from data-dense workflows in the UI to the backend pipelines, integrations, and rule engines that power them. Our scope is broad: you might build a CDC pipeline, design an API, or create a new automation workflow on any given day.




WHAT YOU’LL DO

 - Build fast, intuitive claims workflows in Air that help billers find, understand, correct, and prioritize work, whether they're working one claim or thousands.

 - Design and build full-stack features with React, TypeScript, Python, and PostgreSQL, from user experience and APIs to data models and production operations.

 - Build and scale the claims generation and submission pipeline, transforming encounter data into valid electronic claims across professional, institutional, and dental formats, as well as paper claims when needed.

 - Integrate with clearinghouses and handle the varied responses, verification requirements, and errors that come with getting claims to payers.

 - Improve coverage and payer routing, with guardrails that protect against using the wrong person's coverage information.

 - Build configurable automations and AI-assisted workflows that reduce repetitive work. Give billers and administrators the visibility and control to manage agents and correct mistakes.

 - Use LLMs and agents to streamline customer onboarding and billing setup, helping each customer get configured accurately with as much automation as practical and appropriate human review.

 - Design and build reliable subsystems with clear interfaces and data models. Improve their maintainability and operational stability over time.

 - Solve hard reliability and scale problems, including bulk operations, partial failures, idempotency, performance, observability, and auditability. Find root causes and prevent recurring issues.

 - Work closely with product, design, billing operations, and other engineers to understand real user problems, make thoughtful tradeoffs, and measure improvements in user experience and operational outcomes.


WHAT YOU HAVE

 - 2+ years of professional software development experience building and operating production applications.

 - Strong full-stack engineering skills, including experience with modern frontend frameworks such as React and backend development in Python or Go. Our primary stack includes TypeScript, React, Python, and PostgreSQL.

 - Experience designing and building production subsystems, including their interfaces, reliability, and evolution.

 - Strong technical judgment in ambiguous situations. You can balance speed, correctness, performance, compliance, and simplicity while considering downstream dependencies and future changes.

 - Strong debugging and problem-solving skills, including using monitoring, logging, and alerting to identify root causes and prevent problems from recurring.

 - Product-mindedness and empathy for users: you want to understand how people actually work and build software that makes their jobs easier.

 - Clear communication and collaboration skills.


NICE TO HAVE

 - Experience building data-dense operational tools, workflow automation, bulk operations, or high-volume transaction systems.

 - Familiarity with healthcare billing, claims, EDI, or clearinghouse integrations, or a demonstrated ability to learn a complex domain quickly.

 - Experience shipping AI-assisted features in real workflows, with good judgment about where automation is appropriate and where people need visibility and control.

 - Experience improving React performance, building interactive analytics, or designing intuitive experiences for non-technical users.

 - Experience with cloud infrastructure, containers, CI/CD, and modern observability tools.

 - Experience working in a regulated industry with a focus on security and compliance.

 - A passion for improving healthcare and healthcare operations in America.
